title: A finite module over a finite algebra is finite over the base
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings such that $B$ is a finitely generated $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] (via $\varphi$), and let $M$ be a finitely generated $B$-module. Then $M$, viewed as an $R$-module through $\varphi$, is a finitely generated $R$-module: if $b_1,\dots,b_n$ generate $B$ over $R$ and $m_1,\dots,m_k$ generate $M$ over $B$, the products $b_im_j$ generate $M$ over $R$.
